examples.sql: WITH cte1 AS (SELECT * FROM Rooms) SELECT ID FROM cte1
WITH cte1 AS (SELECT Age FROM Occupants), cte2 AS (SELECT ID FROM Occupants) SELECT * FROM cte2
WITH joincte AS (SELECT Occupants.Species, Rooms.FavFood FROM Occupants FULL JOIN Rooms ON Occupants.ID=Rooms.ID) SELECT * FROM joincte
WITH cte1 AS (SELECT ID FROM Rooms) SELECT ID FROM cte1 UNION SELECT * FROM cte1
WITH cte1 AS (SELECT * FROM Occupants), ctewithincte AS (SELECT Age FROM cte1) SELECT * FROM ctewithincte
